palette-integer-algorithms.subject: Implement exact palette policy algorithms for #1165

tables.domain: ushort health 0..6000; native eight unsigned little-endian thresholds selected by even byte offsets 0..14
tables.interpretation: First nonnegative signed 16-bit health-minus-threshold difference. Differences cannot overflow in supported health range. Adjacent $FFFF at $A5:96FF is unreachable.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all eight bank_A5.asm thresholds and CMP/BPL loop; complete production selector compared with original cartridge threshold scan for all 6001 health inputs.
tables.disposition: Remove threshold array and search; return 2*max(0,7-health/750) after preserving maximum-health validation.
tables.rationale: Uniform integer differences of 750 explain every threshold. Integer quotient directly expresses health bands; no floating point, fitting, interpolation or exceptional corrections needed. Exact multiples belong to higher band.
tables.proofTest: VerifyDraygonHealthPaletteDefinitions (existing test reused; installed color fixture supplied)

tables.domain: even ushort phase byte offsets 0..14 and all ushort health values 0..65535
tables.interpretation: Threshold words are unsigned little-endian. Subtraction wraps to 16 bits then tests sign. Offset 16 is caller-owned completion; odd or later offsets are rejected.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all eight bank_B3.asm thresholds and CMP/BPL/completion flow; complete production result compared with original cartridge thresholds for all 524288 phase/health pairs.
tables.disposition: Remove threshold array; compute 375*(8-phaseByteOffset/2) after offset validation and retain signed wrapped subtraction.
tables.rationale: Uniform integer differences of 375 exactly explain the threshold domain. A direct unsigned health comparison would change supported wrap behavior; formula changes only the selected threshold.
tables.proofTest: VerifyBotwoonHealthPaletteDefinitions (existing test reused; installed color fixture supplied)

tables.nativeIdentity: $A8:CCC9+10*i timer field of palette records; $A8:CC67 graphics hook
tables.domain: ushort byte offsets 0,10,20,30,40,50; normalization additionally accepts terminator offset 60
tables.interpretation: Six unsigned little-endian duration words interleaved with four color words. Native cursor advances ten bytes. Negative color word at $A8:CCFD resets cursor before reading the next timer.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all six bank_A8.asm records and native timer/advance/reset flow; compare every production duration to cartridge, verify terminator, rejected offsets and 193-call production cadence.
tables.disposition: Remove duration array; return record%3==0 ? 64 : 16 after existing alignment/range validation.
tables.rationale: Two exact repetitions of a three-record timing policy. Bounded modulo clearly names cadence and does not admit invalid inputs. Colors are separately owned presentation data, not covered by this disposition.
tables.proofTest: VerifyWorkRobotPaletteTimingDefinitions (existing test reused; duration rejection assertions extended)
